items.name: Approved post publisher
items.desc: Publishes only the sheet rows you marked approved, once, then marks them posted.
items.guardrails: Posts only rows with status = approved, and writes status = posted right after to prevent duplicates.

items.name: Calendar prep brief
items.desc: Each morning, lists today's meetings with who is in them and what you last discussed.
items.guardrails: Uses only your own calendar and notes. Nothing is shared outside your chat.

items.name: Contract clause flagger
items.desc: Reads a contract PDF and lists risky clauses (payment, termination, liability) with the page text quoted.
items.guardrails: Quotes the exact text for every flag so you can verify. It is a checklist, not legal advice.

items.name: CV screener with review queue
items.desc: Scores each CV against a role brief on skills only and queues a ranked list for a human. It never rejects anyone.
items.guardrails: Name, age, gender and photo are removed before scoring. Every candidate stays in the queue; a person decides.

items.name: Daily research brief
items.desc: Reads your chosen feeds each morning and sends the five items worth your time, each with its link.
items.guardrails: Every item keeps its original link so you can verify. The model picks, it does not rewrite facts.

items.name: Deploy failure alert
items.desc: Receives a CI or deploy webhook and sends a plain summary of what failed, with a link.
items.guardrails: Strips tokens and long logs before alerting. Sends only to your own chat.

items.name: Discord moderation flag
items.desc: Flags messages that look like spam or abuse to a mod channel. It never deletes or bans.
items.guardrails: Flag-only. A human moderator takes every action.

items.name: Document Q and A ingest
items.desc: Splits a document into chunks with sources, so answers can cite the exact passage.
items.guardrails: Each chunk keeps its file name and position, so every answer can be checked.

items.name: Draft replies for approval
items.desc: Writes a reply draft in Gmail for each new email and pings you. It never sends.
items.guardrails: Output is a Gmail draft only. Sending stays a human click.

items.name: GitHub issue triage
items.desc: Labels new GitHub issues (bug, feature, question) and comments with what is missing. It never closes anything.
items.guardrails: Adds a label and one comment only. Issue text is treated as untrusted data.

items.name: Grounded cold outreach
items.desc: Reads each lead's real website and drafts an email using only what is on the page. Thin sites go to a human.
items.guardrails: If the page has under 300 characters of text, no draft is written and the row is flagged for review. Nothing is sent.

items.name: Inbox triage digest
items.desc: Every morning, sorts unread email into urgent, needs reply, FYI and junk, then sends one short digest to Telegram.
items.guardrails: Reads only subject, sender and the first 500 characters. It never replies, deletes or labels anything.

items.name: Invoice overdue reminder
items.desc: Finds unpaid invoices past due and drafts a polite reminder for each, for you to send.
items.guardrails: Drafts only. Never emails a client on its own.

items.name: Meeting notes to tasks
items.desc: Turns a transcript into a summary and a task list, and creates Notion pages for the tasks.
items.guardrails: Tasks without an owner are marked 'unassigned' rather than guessed.

items.name: Nightly backup check
items.desc: Confirms last night's backup exists and is not suspiciously small, and alerts if not.
items.guardrails: It only checks; it never deletes or restores backups.

items.name: Phishing check
items.desc: Scores each new email for phishing from its headers, links and wording, then alerts you only on risky ones.
items.guardrails: Never opens links or attachments. Only extracts link text and domains for the model to judge.

items.name: Product review digest
items.desc: Reads new reviews of your product each week and lists the top three complaints with real quotes.
items.guardrails: Every theme has at least one verbatim quote. No quote, no theme.

items.name: Receipt extractor
items.desc: Pulls date, vendor and total from emailed receipts into a sheet, and flags anything it is unsure about.
items.guardrails: Writes rows with a confidence flag. Low-confidence rows are marked for manual check, never guessed.

items.name: Slack standup collector
items.desc: Asks each person three questions every weekday and posts one combined summary for the team.
items.guardrails: Skipped answers are listed as 'no update', not filled in.

items.name: Social comment reply drafts
items.desc: Drafts replies to new comments in your tone and stores them for you to approve. It never replies itself.
items.guardrails: Drafts go to a sheet. Abusive or sensitive comments are skipped and flagged.

items.name: SSL expiry watch
items.desc: Checks your domains daily and warns 21 days before a certificate expires.
items.guardrails: Read-only checks. Alerts once per domain per week.

items.name: Stale lead nudge
items.desc: Finds leads with no contact in 7 days and sends you a short list with a suggested next step.
items.guardrails: Read-only on the sheet. It suggests, you decide who to contact.

items.name: Support form triage
items.desc: Scores each support form submission for priority, logs it, and pings you on urgent ones.
items.guardrails: Adds a priority and one-line summary. It does not reply to the customer.

items.name: Survey sentiment report
items.desc: Reads new survey answers, tags the sentiment and themes, and sends a weekly one-screen report.
items.guardrails: Counts are computed in code. Quotes shown are the real answers.

items.name: Uptime watch
items.desc: Checks your sites every 5 minutes and alerts once when one goes down, and once when it recovers.
items.guardrails: Keeps state so it alerts on change, not every 5 minutes.

items.name: Video to content pack
items.desc: When a new video appears in a feed, drafts a title, a post and a short thread into a review sheet.
items.guardrails: Drafts land in a sheet with status 'draft'. Nothing is posted automatically.

items.name: Voice note to notes
items.desc: Send a voice note to a Telegram bot and get back a clean summary and to-dos.
items.guardrails: Only your own chat id is accepted; messages from anyone else are ignored.

items.name: Weekly metrics summary
items.desc: Every Monday, reads your tracking sheet, computes the week-on-week change, and sends a short plain-language summary.
items.guardrails: The math is done in code. The model only words the result and cannot change the numbers.

items.name: WhatsApp FAQ with human handoff
items.desc: Answers common questions from your FAQ sheet and hands anything uncertain to a person.
items.guardrails: Answers only from the FAQ text. If it is not covered, it says so and pings you instead of guessing.

items.name: WordPress draft from outline
items.desc: Expands an outline into a draft post in WordPress, as a draft only.
items.guardrails: Always creates status = draft. Nothing is published without you.
